title: Maximum 24-Layer Stack with 550nm Quarter-Wave Seeding
scientific_hypothesis: Increasing layer count from 22 to 24 while maintaining quarter-wave initialization at 550nm (visible band center) will provide additional optical degrees of freedom to improve stopband reflectance uniformity across 450-650nm without compromising 700-1000nm transmittance.
design_principle: Quarter-wave baseline initialization at center wavelength of high-reflectance band, followed by gradient-based thickness optimization with bounded search space.
proposed_topology: exactly 6 alternating TiO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers)
soft_objectives: balance s and p polarization response at 45°
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds [20, 180] nm for physical realizability
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory: reflectance bandwidth scales with index contrast and layer count
Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference at oblique incidence
expected_advantages: Two additional layer pairs provide extra stopband shaping capability
550nm center wavelength aligns with RGB channel sensitivity peak
known_risks: Additional layers increase total thickness and potential stress
May not improve score if 22L already near theoretical limit for this material pair
Polarization splitting at 45° may limit simultaneous s/p optimization
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate at 45 degree incidence. Initialize thicknesses using quarter-wave optical thickness at 550nm (TiO2 approximately 57nm, SiO2 approximately 96nm physical thickness). Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with bounds [20, 180] nm per layer. Evaluate performance for both s and p polarizations across 450-650nm (target high reflectance) and 700-1000nm (target high transmittance). Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 6 alternating TiO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Increased layer count from 22 to 24 (maximum allowed) to exploit additional optical degrees of freedom while maintaining quarter-wave initialization principle from prior successful iterations.
